items.title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
items.raw_content: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India. more…
items.title_zh: 亚马逊将在印度部署 3,000 多辆塔塔电动配送车
items.summary: Amazon plans to deploy more than 3,000 Tata electric delivery trucks in India, extending its global fleet electrification push beyond the US.

items.title: Oppo reportedly cancels Find X10 Ultra thanks to RAMageddon
items.raw_content: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra was my favorite new phone of 2026 but, thanks to RAMageddon, the company is apparently canceling its sequel. more…
items.title_zh: 受内存涨价影响，OPPO 据报取消 Find X10 Ultra
items.summary: Oppo has reportedly canceled the Find X10 Ultra, the sequel to its Find X9 Ultra, because of the memory-price surge dubbed "RAMageddon."

items.title: Tesla deemed liable for fraud after Solar Roof ‘experiment’ on a home
items.raw_content: A California judge has deemed Tesla liable for fraud in a Solar Roof lawsuit, after the company repeatedly failed to hand over evidence. Tesla had already admitted it breached the contract, broke its warranty, and was negligent on the job. The homeowner says fixing the damage will cost “well over $2.5 million.” Tesla once offered him $5,000. more…
items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Solar Roof 被加州法院判定欺诈
items.summary: A California judge deemed Tesla liable for fraud in a Solar Roof lawsuit after the company repeatedly failed to hand over evidence; Tesla had already admitted breach of contract, warranty violations and negligence, while the homeowner says repairs will cost well over $2.5 million.

items.title: Google Messages homepage redesign: Pinned chat avatars, bottom search, corner Gemini

items.summary: Google Messages for Android is testing a homepage redesign with pinned chat avatars, a bottom search bar and a Gemini shortcut in the corner, alongside a new app icon.

items.title: Honda just showed off its first high-end electric mountain bike
items.raw_content: Honda makes just about everything with a motor, from lawnmowers and generators to cars, motorcycles, and even airplanes. Now the Japanese giant is adding another electrified vehicle to the list – a premium electric mountain bike. more…
items.title_zh: 本田发布首款高端电动山地自行车
items.summary: Honda showed off its first high-end electric mountain bike, adding a premium e-bike to a product lineup that already spans cars, motorcycles, generators and aircraft.

items.title: 5 American, 6 Canadian: Workhorse W56 arrives in the True North
items.raw_content: Electric truck brand Workhorse is bringing its W56 Class 5 and 6 electric trucks to Canada thanks to a new agreement with a Canadian dealer group and fleet management provider offering truck and trailer sales, parts, repair, and 24/7 roadside assistance and towing services across the Northern nation. more…
items.title_zh: Workhorse W56 电动卡车进入加拿大市场
items.summary: Electric truck maker Workhorse is bringing its W56 Class 5 and 6 trucks to Canada through an agreement with a Canadian dealer group and fleet management provider offering sales, parts, repair and 24/7 roadside assistance.
